name: 并发安全、热路径与事件驱动

question.instructions: Evaluate Concurrency, Hot Path Performance, Event-Driven Scheduling, and Resource Invariants: (1) no coarse-grained method-level exclusive locks on hot read paths; (2) no blocking I/O, external DB probing, or sleep inside held locks, critical hot paths, or lightweight heartbeats; (3) async coordination must be driven by explicit completion signals or event streams rather than speculative busy/sleep polling (periodic checks/debounces when needed must be explicitly bounded and idle-silent); (4) slot/permit/resource invariants must hold: acquired permits must be released symmetrically back to the exact pool/owner they came from, without guessing ownership from global counters or skipping release on disabled/exception paths.

criteria.passed: Uses fine-grained locking or lock-free structures on hot paths; keeps critical sections and heartbeats non-blocking over local in-memory state; drives async completion via explicit events/signals (bounded and idle-silent if polling/debounce is needed); preserves resource/permit conservation with exact acquire/release pairing across all exit and toggle paths.
criteria.violated: Coarse method-level exclusive lock on hot read path, blocking I/O or external sync probe inside lock/heartbeat/hot path, speculative unbounded sleep/timer polling replacing completion events, or broken resource/permit conservation (e.g., guessing release target from global counters or leaking acquired permits when disabled/throwing).

why: 核心正交架构红线：高并发热路径无大锁且临界区禁阻塞外查；异步协作优先事件/信号驱动；并发资源与信号量借还必须守恒且精确配对归还。
